events.verdict: Hart (LAL) firms up in a screening position in Millsap's (DEN) path and does not deliver the contact.
Millsap (Den) makes marginal contact with James (LAL) during his drive that does not affect his SQBR.
Millsap (DEN) makes marginal contact with Kuzma's (LAL) arm after the dunk.
Ball (LAL) wraps his arm around Jokic's (DEN) leg and initiates the contact and a personal foul should have been called instead of an offensive foul on Jokic.
Hart (LAL) establishes himself in a screening position in Millsap's (DEN) path and absorbs the contact.
Harris (DEN) briefly places two hands on Ball (LAL) and disengages without affecting his SQBR.
Millsap (DEN) maintains a legal guarding position during the drive by James (LAL).
Millsap (DEN) legally contests the jump shot by James (LAL).
Correctly called 24 second violation.
While moving in the same direction, Kuzma (LAL) briefly places his right arm on the opposite side of Millsap (DEN) but quickly slides it off as he crosses the lane.
James (LAL) briefly places his hand on the opposite side of Jokic (DEN) but he immediately corrects and slides it off.
Ball (LAL) has his hand placed on Jokic (DEN) but the contact is marginal.
Murray (DEN) loses control of the ball, but not as a result of any contact from a Lakers player.

Hart (LAL) jumps A to B into the body of Murray (DEN) during his shooting motion and the contact affects his jump shot. The contact occurs to Murray's hip and is not a result of Murray extending his leg and creating any contact.
Ball (LAL) briefly grasps Millsap's (DEN) arm and immediately releases it.
Millsap (DEN) makes marginal contact with James' (LAL) arm after his gather that does not affect his driving shot attempt.
Jokic (DEN) sets the screen on Hart (LAL) and does not give him room to avoid the contact.
RAR shows Jokic (DEN) grabs and pulls Hart's (LAL) left arm, affecting his ability to defend the play.
Lyles (DEN) commits a take foul on Kuzma (LAL).
Craig (DEN) commits a take foul on Hart (LAL).
James (LAL) maintains a legal guarding position on Murray's (DEN) jump shot. He makes incidental contact with Murray's arm following the release of the jump shot.
Millsap (DEN) commits a take foul on James (LAL).
Jokic (DEN) firms up in a screening position in Hart's (LAL) path and absorbs the contact.
James (LAL) is in legal guarding position when he absorbs the contact from Murray (DEN) during his drive.
Lyles (DEN) and Stephenson (LAL) briefly engage and disengage during rebounding.
